title: Those Who Contemplate The Word
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 35
summary: This shabad opens with those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are filled with the Fear of God. It turns the heart toward they alone see the Lord, unto whom He reveals Himself. O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find Him.
whyItMatters: It matters when life feels foggy, uncertain, and hesitant because the shabad keeps doubt inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private momentum.
takeaway: Keep returning to this turn: They alone see the Lord, unto whom He reveals Himself. O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa bhau tin paion jin gur kaa sabadh beechaar ||
lines.translation: Those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are filled with the Fear of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gatee sadhaa mil rahe sache ke gun saar ||
lines.translation: They remain forever merged with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; they dwell upon the Glories of the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhubidhaa mail chukaieean har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: They cast off the filth of their mental duality, and they keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sachee baanee sach man sache naal piaar ||1||
lines.translation: True is their speech, and true are their minds. They are in love with the True One. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere haumai mail bhar naal ||
lines.translation: O my mind, you are filled with the filth of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har niramal sadhaa sohanaa sabadh savaaranahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Lord is eternally Beautiful. We are adorned with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabadh man mohiaa prabh aape le milai ||
lines.translation: God joins to Himself those whose minds are fascinated with the True Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadhin naame ratiaa jotee jot samai ||
lines.translation: Night and day, they are attuned to the Naam, and their light is absorbed into the Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਹੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jotee hoo prabh jaapadhaa bin satagur boojh na pai ||
lines.translation: Through His Light, God is revealed. Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa satagur bheTiaa tin aai ||2||
lines.translation: The True Guru comes to meet those who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai sabh ddumanee dhoojai bhai khuaai ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, all are miserable. In the love of duality, they are ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis bin ghaRee na jeevadhee dhukhee rain vihai ||
lines.translation: Without Him, I cannot survive even for an instant, and my life-night passes in anguish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam bhulaanaa a(n)dhulaa fir fir aavai jai ||
lines.translation: Wandering in doubt, the spiritually blind come and go in reincarnation, over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nadhar kare prabh aapanee aape le milai ||3||
lines.translation: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, He blends us into Himself. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh sunadhaa vekhadhaa kiau mukar piaa jai ||
lines.translation: He hears and sees everything. How can anyone deny Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੋ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paapo paap kamaavadhe paape pacheh pachai ||
lines.translation: Those who sin again and again, shall rot and die in sin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so prabh nadhar na aaviee manmukh boojh na pai ||
lines.translation: God's Glance of Grace does not come to them; those self-willed manmukhs do not obtain understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੫੬॥
lines.transliteration: jis vekhaale soiee vekhai naanak gurmukh pai ||4||23||56||
lines.translation: They alone see the Lord, unto whom He reveals Himself. O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find Him. ||4||23||56||

structure: It opens by naming the condition without ornament: those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are filled with the Fear of God.
The middle movement widens the correction through the True Guru comes to meet those who have such pre-ordained destiny.
It closes with a return you can actually keep: they alone see the Lord, unto whom He reveals Himself. O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find Him.
